description: April 4 birthday meaning: Aries decan 2, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 4 birthday falls in Aries, in the second decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Sun as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: The April 4 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Fourteen degrees into Aries, April 4 brings the steady, practical 4 into a sign that usually prefers speed. With the Sun sub-ruling the decan, pride in good work is a recurring theme. The traditional picture is a disciplined go-getter, energetic but organised, who likes to see effort turn into something durable.

Astronomically, April 4 puts the Sun near 14° Aries in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Sun. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aries the Sun takes over as sub-ruler, lending this middle decan some of Leo's warmth and sense of occasion. The Martian drive is still there, yet it is often aimed at something worth being seen for: a cause, a team, a creative project with their name on it. Traditional writers associate this stretch with pride in the good sense, a wish to lead by example rather than by force. Generosity tends to come easily, and so can a sensitivity to being overlooked. A useful question for these Aries natives is whose applause actually matters, since chasing everyone's can scatter a strong fire.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for April 4
paragraphs: A 4th-of-the-month birthday gives a birthday number of 4, with no further reduction needed. In numerology the birth day acts as a supplementary number, describing practical talents that sit beside the Life Path. The 4 stands for the square: four walls, four seasons, a stable base. Anyone born on the 4th is often pictured as organised, trustworthy and good at turning plans into schedules. They tend to prefer a method that has been tested to one that merely sounds exciting. The growing edge for 4s is usually flexibility, letting the structure bend when circumstances genuinely change.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an April 4 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous April 4 birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 4 is the 94th day of the year (95th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Taurus, is usually complete within 16 days, by April 20.

By April 4 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an April 4 birthday are Maya Angelou (1928), Heath Ledger (1979) and Andrei Tarkovsky (1932).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 4?
faq.answer: April 4 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aries, which tradition links with Sun.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 4?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 4 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 4th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 4?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 4, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 4?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on April 4 include Maya Angelou (1928), Heath Ledger (1979) and Andrei Tarkovsky (1932). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
